The '''''Meson Martinet''''' was a heavily modified [[CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle]]<ref name="EOFSAOV" /> [[captain]]ed by [[Sidon Ithano]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Endor]], its [[Sidon Ithano's pirate crew|crew]] consisted of [[First Mate|first mate]] [[Quiggold]], the [[Ishi Tib]] [[Pendewqell]], the [[Arcona]] [[Reeg Brosna]], the [[Twi'lek]] [[Reveth]] and the [[Gamorrean]] [[Na'Vrokk|Squeaky]], all of whom called the [[planet]] [[Ponemah Terminal]] home. On Ponemah, the crew became involved in a [[Hunt for Dooku's Treasure|race]] for the lost treasure of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]], during which Pendewqell was [[Death|killed]] and Brosna was lost in a [[sandstorm]]. The treasure turned out to be the [[Cryo-cycle stasis|cryogenically frozen]] [[clone trooper]] [[Kix|CT-6116]], who joined Ithano's crew once they thawed him out.<ref name="TCC" /> Not long before the [[Battle of Exegol]], they [[Unidentified icy asteroid|rendezvoused]] with the [[sail barge]] ''[[Galleon]]'' of the [[pirate]] gang [[Warbird gang]] led by the [[Quarren]] Captain [[Kragan Gorr]] and made a substantial sale of a vintage cache of [[B1's B2-series super battle droid battalion|super battle]] [[B2-series super battle droid|droid]]s and one [[B1 (Colossus)|B1]] battle droid.<ref name="The Mutiny" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Meson_Martinet.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Meson Martinet'' incorrectly depicted as an XS freighter in ''Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide'']]
The ''Meson Martinet'' was first mentioned in "[[The Crimson Corsair and the Lost Treasure of Count Dooku]]," a short story written by [[Landry Q. Walker]] and released as an [[eBook]] in [[2015]]. The ship was first depicted in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].

The ''Meson Martinet'' is erroneously depicted as an [[XS stock light freighter]] in ''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]''. It was incorrectly spelled as ''Mason Martinette'' in a video on the Star Wars Kids YouTube channel.<ref name="Every Ship in ST">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Ship in the Star Wars Sequel Trilogy|video=bb3vhWXClTY|nolive=1}}</ref> The design of the<ref name="Tipping Point Trivia">{{SW|url=tipping-point-trivia-gallery|text="Tipping Point" Trivia Gallery | The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 3}}</ref> [[YG-4214 mining freighter]] ''[[Remora]]'',<ref name="CGttSWG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> that first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' episode "[[Tipping Points]]",<ref name="Tipping Point">{{TBB|Tipping Point}}</ref> was based on the ''Meson Martinet''.<ref name="Tipping Point Trivia" />
